items.title: Percy Gabriel Interview, 1987-07-10
items.q: I had the band, and I used Earl Palmer on drums. My brother, man, he was on clarinet. Well, he was on trumpet. He was in Lyra's band, too, and he's quit playing, so I understand Danny tried to get him back. And Walter Daniels was on piano on that.

ctx.x: Where were you when you, well, did you record with Walter Brown?

No, Walter Brown had already made his hits, Confessing the Blues and so forth. Yeah. And Walter Brown, well, let's say, did we have, I don't remember whether we had a session with Walter Brown or not. But anyway, the only one thing I could remember about Walter Brown, we played the Paradise Theatre in Detroit. Mm-hmm. And Walter Brown run up a big bill at the hotel, Gotham Hotel. And he wanted Mike Shan to pay the bill, it was more than his salary. And it seemed like Walter Brown must have had a habit of doing…
Yes. Is he any kid to Blues Bailey? That was Blues Bailey.
